Name: Ran's Suits and Tuxedos
Author: ranfuu
Description:
[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/20301279][/url]
[b]! MAY 2020 UPDATE:[/b]
JA conversion for Stardew 1.4 provided by
ParadigmNomad, minervamaga, and SpringsSong
(many thanks!)

REQUIREMENTS:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4798]Tailor Mouse[/url]﻿

---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/center]Use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2718]Fancy Farmer[/url] for long sleeves and pants
[b]
FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*]16 new suits/tuxedos
[*]Made to match with the bachelors (6 vanilla, 6 VCSO)
[*]Doesn't replace any vanilla shirts
[/list][b]
REQUIREMENTS:[/b]
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

[b]INSTALL:[/b]
- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Place in your “\Stardew Valley\Mods” folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[b]UNINSTALL:[/b]
- Simply remove from folder

[b]CREDIT:[/b]
[b]- [/b]JA Conversion by[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26612284]ParadigmNomad[/url][b], [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51777556]minervamaga[/url][b], [/b]and[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/20301279]SpringsSong[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942]Crossy's Visual Crossing Sprite Overhaul[/url] as design basis for the shirts that pair with their version of bachelor sprites
- [url=http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/]http://mayorfuu.tumblr.com/[/url]

[b]Personal edits ok
Please do not reupload/redistribute[/b]
